Condensate Extraction Pump 
 Motor A&B-6.3kv
 CTV500V4

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which 
must be performed on yearly bases or 8000 operation hours as indicated Y1 or 
H8000 in 
the title block .

This document initiated by eng. El-Saeid Mohamed 
 Matarid, tested by eng. Ashraf Kamal El-Din Otba, reviewed by eng. Reda Ragab 
 Karam, approved by eng. Hamdy Ahmed Dorgham general director, accepted by eng. 
 Maamoun Abou El-Magd Atta Allah head sector of Damanhour Power Station.

This document certified by eng. Mona El-Sharkawy 
 WEDC inspection & quality control head sector, MPIS coordinator.

A 
work permit must be issued.

The qualified 
maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety helmet, shoes, breathing-mask, safety glasses ... etc.

items:
A 
work permit must be issued.

The qualified 
maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety helmet, shoes, breathing-mask, safety glasses ... etc.
The motor must be out of service.
Circuit breaker in test position.
Suitable tool set, Air Blower, Megger device
Greasing machine, Multimeter.

Fine 
 cloth for cleaning purposes

Brushes 
 (soft brushes)
Clean air - ducts.
Ensure that all fixing bolts are secured.
Ensure that electrical connection are tightened.
Check the isolators and clean it.
Replace the grease.
Measure the winding insulation resistance.
Clean the winding.
Visually examine the winding.
Check operation of the motor from local and remote operation on test position.
Check all protection devices of the motor by protection group.
